text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '7.4'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

    - name: Run wp i18n audit command with JSON format
      run: ./vendor/bin/wp i18n audit --format=json > audit.json

    - name: Run wp i18n audit command with GitHub Actions format
      run: ./vendor/bin/wp i18n audit --format=github-actions > audit-github-actions.txt

    - name: Upload audit results to GitHub Actions artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: audit-results
        path: |
          audit.json
          audit-github-actions.txt
```
